verdict.rationale: Organization workspace administration is a fair question for an AI assistant product, since such products can ship team or enterprise tiers, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows individual-user controls: per-user access approvals, an activity log of approved permissions, a personal training opt-out, and the Forget skill. These are adjacent personal controls, not admin management of members, permissions, or data policies across an organization's workspace. Nothing in the pack shows team or org workspaces, member management, or admin-set policies.
